# Rhosyn Jorvham

Rhosyn Jorvham serves as a Curriculum Integration Specialist at Umbix Dynamics, a leading provider of adaptive tutoring solutions tailored for K-12 schools. Since joining Umbix in 2019, Rhosyn has specialized in designing mastery-based lesson plans and assessments that seamlessly integrate with Umbix’s adaptive learning platform, enabling personalized learning pathways and real-time mastery tracking for students.

Before her current role, Rhosyn spent five years (2014–2019) as an Instructional Designer at Edvanta Systems, where she focused on creating competency-aligned curricula for middle and high school levels. There, she contributed to the development of the “Project Helix” initiative, which introduced formative assessment templates now widely used in blended learning environments. Her work emphasized scaffolding concepts to support mastery learning, laying the groundwork for her later specialization.

One of Rhosyn’s most notable projects at Umbix Dynamics was leading the district-wide rollout of adaptive learning modules in the Ridgewood School District during the 2020–2021 school year. Code-named “Operation Evergreen,” this initiative involved collaborating closely with district curriculum coordinators, lead teachers, and IT staff to customize lesson pathways in math and science, develop teacher dashboards tailored to district needs, and train over 150 educators in adaptive instructional strategies. The success of Operation Evergreen increased student mastery rates by 18% on average in participating schools within the first academic year.

Rhosyn’s approach to her work is highly collaborative and data-driven. She maintains an active partnership with product managers, data analysts, and educational researchers at Umbix Dynamics to continually refine lesson plans based on student performance metrics. She values feedback loops with teachers and district administrators, often leading focus groups to gather insights that inform iterative curriculum improvements.

Her day-to-day responsibilities include designing mastery-aligned assessments, developing teacher dashboard features that highlight student progress gaps, and coordinating cross-functional workshops to align curriculum goals with Umbix’s adaptive platform capabilities. Rhosyn typically works closely with the Client Success team and regional district education officers to ensure smooth implementation and ongoing support.

Known for her meticulous attention to detail and emphasis on practical classroom application, Rhosyn is a key contributor to Umbix Dynamics’ mission of enhancing personalized learning outcomes through mastery tracking and adaptive instruction.
